text.card: A red giant 3,345 parsecs away, 11 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 12, give 0.96 solar masses and 11.3 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,867 K at its surface.
